description:

The Corporate Communications & CSR Specialist sits within the Regional Communications team of Marketing and Services Branch for Asia Pacific Middle East (APME) zone, which is headquartered in Singapore.

The Communications department oversees all of TotalEnergies’ Marketing & Services division’s integrated communications activities in APME zone including corporate and commercial communications covering internal, external, advertising & promotions, sponsorship. The department also manages internal and external communications, and corporate social responsibility for all TotalEnergies subsidiaries in Singapore.

* Support in the organization of **CSR activities** for the Singapore office, including liaison with NGOs and employees, management of the internal platforms, reporting etc.

title: Health, Safety and Environmental Engineer
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION  

REC Group is an international pioneering solar energy company dedicated to empowering consumers with clean, affordable solar power through high-quality solar panels with a leading power density. As Solar's Most Trusted, REC is known for its patented innovations and multiple award-winning products with reliable long-term performance. The cornerstone for REC's strong reliability is advanced and highly efficient manufacturing using Industry 4.0 practices. Founded in 1996 in Norway, REC has always been committed to a low carbon footprint in its solar materials and panels. REC is headquartered in Norway with operational headquarters in Singapore and regional hubs in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. As of December 2021, REC is part of Reliance Industries Limited, India's largest private sector company with revenues of USD 104.6 billion.

Find out more at recgroup.com

  
DESIGNATION : Health, Safety and Environmental Engineer  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES  

We are looking to hire an experienced, highly motivated, hands-on individual who will be responsible for the day to day operations with regards to Health Safety and Environment, so that to achieve ZERO LTI for the plant.

* Team Member of HSE function, drive for continuous improvement by implementing up-to-date standards to comply to local codes requirements.
* Drive towards HSE KPI for Operations and safety awareness programs to promote safety culture mindset.
* Conduct Risk Assessments, Safety audit and improvement.
* Comply with Environmental, Health and Safety requirements, Code of Practice and Guidelines.
* Conduct incident/accident investigation process including root cause analysis and ensure corrective actions are completed.
* Assist/Coordinate WHSE Safety Committee meeting and organize HSE Inspections.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation of the HSE management system.
* Coordinate /Assist /Conduct HSE, CERT and Emergency Response Training and relevant activities.
* Co-ordination between suppliers/ contractors, planning/ scheduling contractors work regarding safety matters.
* Performs other duties as assigned. Duties will vary according to the operational requirements of the department and/or the specific goals of the division.

WORK LOCATION: Onsite at REC Solar, 20 Tuas South Avenue 14 Singapore 637312  
(Company transport available to/from selected locations islandwide.)

  
QUALIFICATIONS  

* Diploma / Engineering Degree with at least 1-3 years relevant experience in the field of HSE. New graduates are also encouraged to apply.

  
  
OTHER INFORMATION  

* Familiar with Microsoft 365 Applications
* Skills and abilities to perform job include: analytical communication, presentation skills, problem solving and troubleshooting skills, computer literacy, interpersonal skills, exercises mature judgment; ability to work in a team, as well as, ability to influence other people
* Must have a good and positive attitude
* A good team player with pleasant personality.
* Work together with shift technicians and coach them

title: Brand Manager, Sustainability
description:
Brand Manager, Sustainability

TÜV SÜD Group – A global leader in the field of testing, inspection, management system certification and product certification renowned for quality, integrity and technical excellence.

Established more than 150 years ago in Germany, TÜV SÜD Group is a leading global provider of technical services with more than 30,000 highly skilled employees across 1,000 offices worldwide. TÜV SÜD Group offers a wide range of testing & product certification, inspection, auditing & system certification, training and knowledge services. We are a premium quality, safety, and sustainability solutions provider.

As a Brand Manager for Sustainability, you bring TÜV SÜD’s global brand strategy to life through impactful activation, strategic storytelling, and sustainability‑driven thought leadership. You will shape how TÜV SÜD shows up in global conversations around innovation, digital transformation, decarbonisation, ESG, and future-readiness, positioning the company as a trusted sustainability partner. This role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, sustainability, market intelligence, and cross-functional collaboration. You will drive global brand initiatives and support executive visibility through strong messaging, thought leadership, and external engagement, acting as the bridge between the Sustainability Office and the Marketing organisation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Brand Activation**

* Develop, lead, and execute global brand campaigns that strengthen TÜV SÜD’s positioning across priority topics including sustainability, innovation, and digital transformation
* Translate brand strategy into clear messaging frameworks, activation concepts, and content for use across global channels and markets
* Collaborate closely with Social Media, Website, and Creative teams to plan, develop, and publish campaign content that is cohesive, impactful, and aligned with overall brand direction
Ensure clarity and consistency of key messages across all brand touchpoints, channels, and regions  

**2. Sustainability Positioning & Thought Leadership**

* Support external engagements (e.g., conferences, panels, interviews) through strategic messaging, content preparation, and visibility initiatives
* Develop and refine key sustainability messages and narratives, ensuring alignment across global functions and leadership
* Develop thought leadership content and marketing materials highlighting TÜV SÜD’s work in decarbonisation, ESG, and future-readiness
* Support executive positioning by developing talking points, narratives, and content for media, panels, and external engagements
* Work with internal experts to translate technical topics into clear, compelling external narratives
Monitor global trends, competitor activity, and emerging sustainability topics to inform brand direction  

**3.** **Strategic Event & Experience Positioning**

* Define a clear strategic perspective on which external events, conferences, and forums serve as true positioning opportunities for TÜV SÜD’s sustainability agenda and where to intentionally *not* participate
* Develop distinctive representation concepts for high impact events (e.g., sustainability summits, industry forums), ensuring TÜV SÜD shows up with a clear point of view rather than a generic presence
* Translate brand and sustainability positioning into compelling on‑site experiences, formats, and narratives that increase visibility, relevance, and memorability
* Shape engaging content concepts around events (before, during, after) that extend reach beyond physical participation and feed into global brand and thought leadership channels
* Collaborate with Marketing, Sustainability, and regional teams to ensure event participation is tightly aligned with brand strategy, messaging priorities, and target audiences
Evaluate impact and visibility outcomes of key engagements to continuously sharpen TÜV SÜD’s approach to experiential brand activation  

**4. Media & External Engagement**

* Support media engagement opportunities, including interviews, panels, and speaking engagements
* Work with PR teams, media partners, and stakeholders to identify and develop opportunities to position TÜV SÜD in key sustainability conversations
Ensure alignment between messaging, thought leadership content, and external visibility efforts  

**5. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the key liaison between the Sustainability Office and the Global Marketing team
* Ensure smooth alignment, clear communication, and consistent messaging across departments
Collaborate closely with Internal Communications, PR, and regional teams to ensure consistency of messaging across internal and external channels  

**Key Requirement**

**Must-have:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or related field
* Min. 6 years of experience in brand management, strategic marketing, sustainability marketing, or communications roles
* Experience in developing and supporting integrated brand or thought leadership initiatives across multiple channels
* Strong ability to translate complex topics into clear, structured messaging and compelling narratives
* Excellent storytelling, writing, and conceptual thinking skills
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in matrixed, global organisations
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and navigate complex organisational environments
* Strong understanding of digital and media landscapes, with awareness of emerging trends and storytelling formats
Open-minded, adaptable, and intellectually curious, with strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to navigate evolving sustainability topics and business environments  

**Nice-to-have:**

* Understanding/interest of sustainability topics (ESG, decarbonisation, climate/green transition)
* Experience working in a technical, B2B, or professional services environment
* Experience in media engagement, PR, or external communications
* Background in thought leadership development or executive communication
* Familiarity with global marketing structures and international collaboration
* Experience supporting global events (e.g., sustainability conferences, industry forums) is an advantage
* Passion for exploring new content approaches, formats, and activation ideas that push creativity and relevance
Fluent in English; additional language proficiency is an advantage  

**What We Offer**

* A meaningful role shaping the sustainability and brand narrative of a global leader in safety, quality, and trust
* Collaboration with international teams across sustainability, marketing, and business units
* Opportunities for professional development within TÜV SÜD’s global organisation
A dynamic, purpose-driven environment with room for creativity and strategic impact

We test, we audit, we inspect, we advise. We never stop challenging ourselves for the safety of society and its people. We breathe technology, we strive for professional excellence, and we leave a mark. We take the future into our hands. We are TÜV SÜD Group.

SP’s Sustainability Office (SO) is a central function that drives SP’s organisation-wide sustainability agenda. SO works with schools, departments, and senior management to translate sustainability strategy into plans and measurable outcomes, and oversees SP’s annual sustainability reporting and related governance processes.
  
  
You will report to the Deputy Director (Sustainability Office). As part of the SO, you will work closely with senior management to develop, communicate and implement SP’s sustainability strategy and plans.

* **Reporting and compliance**

  + Drive annual sustainability reporting cycle, in accordance with prevailing standards and reporting requirements ensuring data accuracy and robustness
  + Establish and maintain clear sustainability data definitions, reporting protocols and quality assurance processes across the organisation

* **Organizational strategy**

  + Articulate processes and plans to review and achieve organisation-level sustainability objectives and targets
  + Monitor and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to electricity, water, greenhouse gas emissions and waste management.
  + Develop and implement organisation-level policies and interventions, taking into account broader organisational priorities and operational considerations to enhance sustainability performance.
  + Scan and synthesise emerging sustainability practices and solutions, to inform strategy development, policy design and stakeholder engagement

* **Communications and engagement**

  + Drive organisational alignment with sustainability plans, through internal (staff and students) and external communications and engagement efforts
  + Support in various internal and external training programmes, management of events, as well as other school and polytechnic level committee work

**[What we are looking for]**

* Strong project, time management and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, work effectively under time pressure, and engage diverse stakeholders across the organisation
* Experience in sustainability reporting with familiarity with recognised sustainability reporting standards (e.g. GRI, IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards (ISSB)). Typically, 3-5 years of relevant experience will be an advantage, particularly in medium to large organisations
* Experience working with multi-source datasets to support reporting and analysis, including the ability to sense check data, identify inconsistencies, and work with stakeholders to resolve data quality issues
* Ability to interpret sustainability performance information to support monitoring of organisational outcomes and inform decision‑making and reporting
* Relevant qualifications or professional training will be an advantage, including but not limited to:

  + Bachelors-level qualifications in areas such as Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Economics or Geography
  + Professional certifications, e.g. ISCA Sustainability Professional, Sustainability or ESG assurance‑related certifications (e.g. sustainability assurance practitioner qualifications), BCA Green Mark Professional, GRI Certified Sustainability Professional

description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------

* 10+ years of analytical experience in sustainable finance and/or capital markets, and 5+ years of experience managing a team delivering financial products or services
* Exceptional ability to build, deepen, and sustain trusted relationships with senior decision makers, including C-suite executives, intermediaries, regulators and market associations.
* Comprehensive understanding of global debt capital markets and the broader financial ecosystem, including credit markets, issuer behavior, market structure, competitive dynamics, and evolving regulatory and investor expectations.
* Operates with a strong sense of urgency: acts with high speed of execution and holds others accountable
* Leads with empathy, integrity, and cultural awareness
* Demonstrates intellectual curiosity and analytical rigor, with a strong appetite for continuous learning
* Acts as an agile change champion, proactively driving transformation, operational efficiency and AI enablement
* Highly effective communicator who influences through clear, compelling narratives
* Fluency in English; fluency in another major Asian language (e.g. Chinese, Japanese, Korean) will be a significant plus

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree required and/or master’s degree preferred in a relevant field (e.g. economics, finance, sustainable development)

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

This Senior Vice President (SVP) role sits within Moody’s Ratings’ sustainable finance assessments team and is a critical part of the firm’s global strategy to build analytical relevance and market leadership in sustainable finance capital markets. Reporting to the Global Head of Sustainable Finance Assessments, the SVP will manage the Asia Pacific analytical team based in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Tokyo, leading the production of high quality assessments to exacting quality and timeline expectations, thematic research, and market outreach.

The role combines analytical leadership, operational oversight, and regional market engagement to expand Moody’s Ratings’ presence and influence in sustainable and transition finance across APAC. This requires building a strong regional network with intermediaries, issuers and other external stakeholders and influencers.

* Develop and implement the strategic, operational, product, research and outreach plan, working closely with other internal stakeholders
* Collaborate with sustainable finance and generalist relationship managers to educate market participants on Moody’s Sustainable Finance offerings
* Develop and execute extensive outreach programs targeting issuers, intermediaries, local industry associations, and other financial market stakeholders (with an expectation to spend approximately 30% of time in external outreach)
* Analyze and understand the key underlying dynamics of sustainable and transition finance in the APAC region with a view to ensuring our products remain fit-for-purpose and can meet local market needs
* Identify opportunities to leverage data and technology to improve operational efficiency, especially in alignment with Moody’s Ratings’ Agentic AI strategy
* Act as a speaker or facilitator at expert panels during internal and external meetings and conferences

**About the Team**
------------------

The Sustainable Finance Group is responsible for delivering Moody’s Ratings’ business plans in one of its four identified growth areas – Sustainable and Transition Finance. This includes supporting the integration of ESG risks into our credit ratings and strengthening Moody’s Ratings’ strategic position as a capital raising partner for issuers.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

description:
**About the Roles**

We are hiring a Sustainability and ESG Lead for a permanent position within the agricultural commodities wholesale sector, based in Somerset. This role operates on a **5.5-day work week (Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM; Sat: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM)** and offers a **competitive salary package with AWS and performance bonuses**. You will play a key role in driving ESG initiatives across regional operations while working closely with senior stakeholders.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design and execute ESG strategies, policies, and ESMS aligned with IFC and UN standards.
* Advise leadership on ESG-related risks and embed sustainability practices across procurement, operations, logistics, and investment activities.
* Lead carbon accounting efforts and conduct climate and deforestation risk analyses.
* Monitor and report on environmental metrics, including wastewater treatment and waste management.
* Oversee social responsibility initiatives covering labor practices, workplace safety, gender equality, and community relations.
* Ensure alignment with frameworks such as the Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights.
* Drive human rights due diligence processes and promote responsible sourcing practices.
* Engage with farmers and local communities to support sustainable agriculture and climate resilience initiatives.
* Prepare ESG reports for financial institutions, DFIs, and investors.
* Track ESG KPIs, coordinate assessments, and manage follow-ups on monitoring activities.
* Support investment processes through ESG due diligence and implementation of ESAPs and CAPs.
* Facilitate ESG audits and contribute to climate risk evaluations.
* Deliver ESG training and guidance to regional teams, fostering awareness across functions.
* Act as the key liaison for ESG matters with investors, auditors, and external consultants.
* Mentor junior team members and ESG trainees.
* Develop and standardize ESG tools, templates, and frameworks for regional adoption.
* Handle additional responsibilities as assigned.

**What We’re Looking For**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Management, Social Sciences, International Development, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* At least 4 years of relevant experience in ESG, sustainability, or E&S risk management, ideally within multi-country or emerging market environments.
* Strong familiarity with ESG frameworks such as IFC Performance Standards, GRI, TCFD, and EcoVadis.
* Hands-on experience in developing and implementing an ESMS is advantageous.
* Excellent analytical and data management capabilities, with the ability to translate ESG standards into actionable business practices.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate across complex supply chains.
* Proven experience in mentoring, training, and building team capabilities, with the confidence to work independently and influence cross-functional teams.

**Note for Applicants**

* Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted, typically within **4 days**.
* Applications can be made via the job portal or by emailing your resume (as an attachment) to **enquiry@erast.​com.​sg** with **4Pabej** in the subject line.

**Date:** 2026-01-08

**Location:** Singapore, , Singapore

**Company:** NCS

**Company Description**

  
  

NCS’s mission is to bring people together and harness technology to advance communities. As a leading technology services firm, operating across Asia Pacific in over 20 cities, our diverse 14,000-strong workforce delivers large-scale, mission-critical projects for governments and enterprises locally and regionally. Our NEXT capabilities of digital, cloud, platforms as well as our core offerings in Applications, Infrastructure, Engineering, and Cyber Security provide end-to-end technology solutions and services to our clients.

  
  

**Job Description**

  
  

As our Sustainability & Community Impact Intern, you will join NCS on our purpose-driven journey to harness technology for good. You’ll play an active role in developing our annual sustainability report, supporting compliance with evolving ESG regulations, and helping to drive our NCS community impact programmes. This internship offers meaningful exposure to both corporate sustainability and social impact, making it ideal for students passionate about making a difference.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Sustainability Reporting**

* Support data collection, calculation, and analysis for environmental and social metrics.
* Assist in drafting sections of the annual sustainability report.
* Stay updated on trends in ESG reporting, regulatory changes, and technology industry standards.

**Community Impact**

* Assist in planning and executing internal sustainability and community outreach events.
* Coordinate communications and logistics with stakeholders and external partners.
* Create sustainability-related content for social media, internal platforms, and newsletters.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  
  

**What You’ll Need to Succeed:**

* Strong analytical skills (e.g., Excel, Power BI).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Interest or prior exposure to sustainability, ESG, or social impact initiatives.
* Willingness to learn, adapt, and take initiative.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work in a dynamic team environment.

*Commencement date:* ***June 2026 (min 5 months full time commitment)***

*The main duties and responsibilities will be subjected to review when there is a change in business requirements and scope of work.*

  
  

**Additional Information**

  
  

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

  

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

  

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

  

Scam Alert

  

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

  

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at reachus@ncs.com.sg.

title: Clean Utility and Sustainability Program Lead
description:
**Job title:** **Clean Utility and Sustainability Program Lead**

* Location: Singapore
* Hiring Manager: Building & Utilities Engineering Manager

**Purpose**

Vaccines M&S is preparing its future through an ambitious program named Modulus. The Modulus Project is at the cornerstone of Sanofi strategy as it aims at creating a new manufacturing concept consisting of a new generation of evolutive multi-product facilities, modular, adaptable, and agile, leveraging new disruptive technologies, to better address vaccine business challenges.

As a Senior Utilities & Sustainability Engineer to take up Utility and HVAC systems from Mechanical completion phase and ensuring the efficient and reliable operation of utility systems essential for the manufacturing process. Your responsibilities encompass the testing, commissioning, qualification, Operation and maintenance of various utility and HVAC systems critical for the production and distribution of vaccines. This role demands a strong understanding of engineering principles, particularly in the realm of utilities within pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.

The Senior Utilities & Sustainability engineer will report to Clean Utilities and Sustainability Manager.

**Key Area 1: Operation and Maintenance of utility systems**

* SME for operation and maintenance of Clean and Black utility systems, and infrastructure services. (Chilled water system, Compressed Air system, Water systems, Steam system, Waste management, RO water, Water for injection, clean gases and solvent systems).
* Coordinate and supervise the operation team to operate all the utility system by 24 X 7 continuous system operation to support plant activities without any interruption.
* Lead for all the trouble shooting of Utility and facility systems.
* Ensure all operation and maintenance activities are meticulously documented to demonstrate compliance with regulatory requirements.

**Key Area 2: Operation and Maintenance of HVAC systems**

* SME for operation and maintenance of HVAC systems, and infrastructure services. (AHU, FCU, Cold-room, DX units, Dehumidifiers) Lead for all the trouble shooting of HVAC systems. In charge for all the clean room operation and testing.
* Ensure all operation and maintenance activities are meticulously documented to demonstrate compliance with regulatory requirements.

**Key Area 3: People Management**

* To oversee and manage the utility team/Technicians.
* Manage 24X7 hrs. Utility and HVAC operation with Utility team.
* Prepare and provide coaching/Training to utility team to improve personal and professional career development.
* Overall supervising the External/Internal integrated facility management team.
* Review and update the operation support documents like SOP, PM plan, Training matrix.
* Lead investigations and root cause analysis of repetitive problems and investigate equipment failures as part of deviation investigation and CAPA.

**Key Area 4: Sustainability Management**

* Responsible for design and implement the sustainability initiatives.
* Utilize quality systems to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Coordinating with statutory authorities for relevant approvals.
* Achieve financial objectives through efficient utility operation, cost improvement actions and optimal cost options.
* Collaborate on interdisciplinary projects and initiatives to optimize operations and drive continuous improvement.
* Conduct site energy conservation audits to identify and implement the Energy conservation measures on utility systems.
* Manage site energy management and water efficiency management systems and prepare reports for submission to statutory agents.

**Pre-requisites**

**Knowledge, Skills and Competencies**

* Proficiency in engineering design software and tools, as well as familiarity with regulatory requirements such as FDA, EMA, HSA regulations and cGMP.
* Proficiency in maintenance and reliability systems, including design, installation, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interacting with internal teams, clients, and stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to diagnose complex technical issues and implement effective solutions.
* Familiarity with relevant industry codes, standards, and safety regulations
* Project ownership and decision-making skills
* Project scheduling & reporting skills
* Ability to lead contingent staffs, external resources, including vendors & contractors.
* Good team player willing to work for the common goal.

**Qualification/Requirement**

* Mechanical/Electrical Engineering Degree from an accredited technical institution.
* Minimum 8 years’ experience in Utility and Facility system operation and maintenance management, preferably with plant operations in engineering field, preferably with pharmaceutical manufacturing experience.
* Minimum of 3 years’ experience in Environment and sustainability engineering.
* Preferred with Singapore Certified Energy manager and Boiler Competence certification. Previous experience in sustainability engineering within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with specific experience in vaccine manufacturing highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
* Commitment to quality, safety, and compliance in all aspects of utility system operation and maintenance.
* Operational standby for emergency system breakdown.

**Other Requirements for this job**

* Familiarity with SAP computerized maintenance management systems is advantageous.
* Familiar with CAPEX project from BOD phase.
